_about: Survivor roster. Values from the FORSAKEN wiki (character pages read 2026-10-01 via the MediaWiki API) unless listed in 'assumed' (no source) or 'undocumented' (wiki marks it as player-observed). Shared base stats from the wiki: walk 12, sprint 26, stamina 100, -10/s, +20/s. See docs/CHARACTERS.md.

characters.name: Noob
characters.summary: Classic noob with a cola, a stone-skin potion and a burger that makes him vanish.

abilities.name: Bloxy Cola
abilities.description: Drink 2.5 s (-10% speed, no sprint): Speed I 10 s and removes Slowness.

abilities.name: Slateskin Potion
abilities.description: Drink 1.5 s: Slateskin III for 6 s (120 overheal, -45% speed, many status immunities). Recast after 2.5 s to end early. Ends with Speed II 2 s (Speed I if cancelled). Cooldown starts after the effect.

abilities.name: Ghostburger
abilities.description: Eat 2 s (-20% speed, no sprint): Undetectable and Invisibility IV for 10 s.

bot.notes: Cola when chased with low stamina; Slateskin when below 50% HP and the killer is close; Ghostburger when cornered.

changes: Bloxy Cola cooldown 50 s (brief assumed 45 s); Speed I 10 s.
Slateskin Potion: Slateskin III (120 overheal) for 6 s, cooldown 46 s starting after the effect; the brief's '2 uses per round' and Slateskin II +80 are outdated.
Ghostburger: Undetectable + Invisibility IV for 10 s, cooldown 40 s (brief: 55 s).

characters.name: 007n7
characters.summary: Exploiter turned survivor: clones, a teleport GUI and remote control of his decoys.

passives.name: DEX
passives.description: Always sees the furthest survivor spawn point.

abilities.name: Clone
abilities.description: Spawns a clone (10 s, his current HP) that follows the Inject mode; 007n7 gets Invisibility IV + Undetectable for 5 s (and a hidden 3 s Helpless).

abilities.name: c00lgui
abilities.description: Channel 5.5 s at -85% speed, then teleport to the DEX spawn. Damage or starting a generator cancels it.

abilities.name: Inject
abilities.description: Cycles the mode future clones use: Aimless (wander), Pathfind (walk to the DEX spawn), Cursor (run where he looks).

bot.notes: Clone when the killer is within ~10 blocks (Pathfind mode leads it away); c00lgui when idle and out of sight.

changes: Clone cooldown 27 s (brief: 40 s); 007n7 gets Invisibility IV + Undetectable 5 s (brief: ~4 s) and no self-Slowness.
c00lgui: 5.5 s channel at -85% speed, cooldown 50 s (brief: 6 s standing still, 60 s).
Inject has no cooldown (brief: 0.75 s).

characters.name: Veeronica
characters.summary: TV-headed robot skater: sprays graffiti zones and skates through them; heals only from her battery.

passives.name: Metal Frame
passives.description: Cannot be healed by anything except her battery. Battery starts at 30%, +8% per generator puzzle; 100% = 50 HP (2% per HP).

abilities.name: Vandalism
abilities.description: Spray graffiti on a wall you face (5 s, stand still). Max 3; each makes a 12x30x12-stud zone only she sees. The killer can destroy graffiti (5 HP).

abilities.name: Sk8
abilities.description: Start inside a graffiti zone: skate at 1.15x sprint speed, 1.35x stamina drain, limited steering. Jump near a wall to Trick (+4 stamina, crash immunity). Crashing: 5 damage + Slowness IV 2.5 s.

abilities.name: Broadcast
abilities.description: Cycles the Sk8 collision mode: Phase (pass through the killer: Resistance II 3 s + Speed II 1.5 s, +15% battery), Bumper (knock the killer back, 5 damage, +15% battery, 20 s lockout), Mobile (better steering after tricks).

abilities.name: Activate Battery
abilities.description: Heals 1 HP/s from the battery (2% per HP) until full, empty, or damaged. 1 s cooldown if used at full HP or 0%.

bot.notes: Sprays graffiti near generators and loops; skates on graffiti when chased; uses the battery when safe and hurt.

changes: HP 100 confirmed (brief: [assumed] 100).
Battery: starts at 30%, +8% per generator puzzle, 50 HP at 100%; heals 1 HP/s.
Activate Battery cooldown 75 s; Vandalism max 3 graffiti, 5 s spray.
Broadcast modes per the wiki; Phase gives Resistance II 3 s + Speed II 1.5 s (brief: Resistance I + Speed IV).

characters.name: Guest 1337
characters.summary: Ex-soldier guest: blocks basic attacks, then parry-punches the killer into a stun.

passives.name: Self Sacrifice
passives.description: When survivors are stacked, Guest takes the hit (higher still while blocking).

abilities.name: Block
abilities.description: Resistance V 1 s, -50% speed 1.75 s. Blocking a basic attack: +10 overheal (max 30), Speed I 2 s, Strength I 5 s, killer slowed 30% 1 s, Punch reset and Parry Punch ready. Blocking another ability breaks the block (-40% damage, Resistance II 3 s).

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Shoulder dash 1.5 s (no stamina regen). Hit the killer: 5 damage, 6-11 stud knockback, Resistance III 0.5 s; 20 s per-killer lockout. Miss: Slowness II for 3-15 s by distance.

abilities.name: Punch
abilities.description: 0.6 s windup: 25 damage, Helpless + Slowness I 2 s, knockback. After a successful Block it becomes Parry Punch: 35 damage (42 with Strength), 2 s stun.

bot.notes: Blocks when the killer winds up a basic attack nearby (with reaction delay), Parry Punch right after, Charge to peel the killer off allies.

changes: Revamped in update 4.1.6 (May 2026) and tuned again by 5.0.0: HP 110 (Made to Last +10, brief: +15 / 115).
Block only fully blocks basic attacks; success grants overheal, Strength I and a Parry Punch (brief: Resistance V + Slowness IV 2 s, Punch charges).
Charge: 5 damage + knockback, 20 s per-killer lockout (brief: 15 HP on chained charges).
Regular Punch no longer stuns; Parry Punch stuns 2 s. Punch has a 55 s cooldown (brief: charge-based).

characters.name: Shedletsky
characters.summary: Former Roblox admin with a sword stun and fried chicken heals.

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: 0.55 s windup with Resistance II, then a sword arc: 30 damage and a 3 s stun. Slowed 75% for 1.4 s.

abilities.name: Fried Chicken
abilities.description: 2 per round: heal 5 now + 25 over 10 s; slowed 75% for 3 s. Not at full HP; 5+ damage cancels the healing.

bot.notes: Slashes the killer when close and facing him; eats chicken when safe below 65% HP.

changes: Slash cooldown 40 s (brief: 4 s), 30 damage + 3 s stun with Resistance II during the windup.
Fried Chicken heals 5 + 25 over 10 s (brief: +35).

characters.name: Chance
characters.summary: Gambler: coin flips build charges for a revolver that might stun the killer — or explode.

passives.name: Unpredictable Fate
passives.description: Max HP is random between 70 and 90 each round.

abilities.name: Coin Flip
abilities.description: Heads: +1 charge to every other ability (max 3). Tails: +1 Vulnerable tier for 15 s. Each tails in a row adds +2.5% heads chance.

abilities.name: One Shot
abilities.description: 1 s windup. Success (50/70/90% at 1/2/3 charges): 50 damage, stun 1-4 s by distance (90 studs). Misfire: nothing. Explosion: 25 self-damage, gun breaks until Hat Fix, nearby killer stunned 5 s. Uses all charges.

abilities.name: Reroll
abilities.description: New max HP = random 55-120 x (1 + 0/5/10% at 1/2/3 charges), cap 130; keeps the HP percentage. Uses all charges.

abilities.name: Hat Fix
abilities.description: Needs 3 charges: resets Vulnerable, repairs a broken One Shot. Uses all charges.

bot.notes: Flips coins while abilities are on cooldown, fires One Shot when the killer is in range with 2+ charges, Hat Fix when Vulnerable is high or the gun broke.

changes: Role: Sentinel only (wiki character page: 'a Sentinel Survivor'); the brief listed a Sentinel vs Survivalist conflict.
There are no dice: the kit is Coin Flip / One Shot / Reroll / Hat Fix with shared charges (brief: d4 roll).
Max HP random 70-90 at round start; Reroll 55-120 (+bonus), cap 130; stamina is fixed at 100.
Tails gives Vulnerable (+20% damage taken per tier), not Weakness.
One Shot at 0 charges is not described by the wiki: 30% success / 35% misfire / 35% explosion [assumed] (extrapolated from the +20%/-10% per charge rule).

characters.name: Two Time
characters.summary: Cultist with a sacrificial dagger who can come back once from a ritual circle.

passives.name: Oblation
passives.description: Damaging the killer fills Oblation (front stab +20%, backstab +40%). With a full meter and a Ritual placed, a lethal hit starts a second life at the Ritual: 50 HP, +40% stamina, cleared statuses, 2 s invincible, Speed II 6 s, Vulnerable V 12 s.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Dagger
abilities.description: 0.25 s windup, Resistance I 0.7 s. Front: 10 damage + Slowness II + Helpless 1 s. Backstab: 20 damage + 2 s stun. While crouched: 22-stud lunge, backstab stun 3.5 s.

abilities.name: Crouch
abilities.description: Up to 15 s: Undetectable + Invisibility III, walk 10 / run 20, building up to +40% running at the killer over 4 s. Leaving within 30 studs of the killer gives Speed II 1 s.

abilities.name: Pray
abilities.description: Kneel at your Ritual and turn Oblation into HP (1 HP per 2%).

abilities.name: Ritual
abilities.description: 4 s windup: carves your respawn point. Required for the second life. In LMS the second life triggers in place even without a full meter.

bot.notes: Places the Ritual early near the spawn side, crouches to approach, backstabs when the killer is turned away, prays when safe.

changes: Current kit (wiki, July 2026 rework): Oblation, Sacrificial Dagger, Crouch, Pray, Ritual. The brief's default 'Oblation' version is kept and updated: second life 50 HP (brief: 40), backstab stuns, Pray added.
'Undying Devotion' is the oldest (2025) kit; still available via config.twoTimeVariant = "undying_devotion" (40 HP revive, Speed II 6 s, 1.5 s invincible, Vulnerable V 12 s).
Dagger damage 10 front / 20 back (brief: 25).

characters.name: Jane Doe
characters.summary: Crystal-throwing sentinel who marks the killer with Resonance, then stuns with her hatchet.

passives.name: Digital Footprint
passives.description: Sees the killer's footprints: red, then yellow, then gone.

passives.name: Shatterpoint
passives.description: Extra 20-30 HP pool that takes 40% less damage. Only her landed abilities restore it. At 0 it is locked for 40 s, then returns with 5.

abilities.name: Crystal Pitch
abilities.description: Charge up to 2 s (-30% speed), throw an arcing crystal that explodes. Survivor: Purified I 3 s, +2 SHP. Killer: +1 Resonance (II from 110+ studs), +3 SHP, but Jane is revealed 3 s.

abilities.name: Hatchet
abilities.description: 0.75 s windup, lunge, 25 damage (10 vs John Doe). No Resonance: Helpless I + Slowness II 2 s, +5 SHP. Resonance I/II/III: stun 2.5/3.5/4.5 s, +10/20/30 SHP; consumes Resonance.

bot.notes: Pitches crystals at the killer from range to build Resonance, Hatchet when Resonance >= 1, pitches at hurt allies for Purified.

changes: Shatterpoint returns with 5 SHP after the 40 s lockout (wiki undocumented).
Resonance lasts 30 s (not stated in the brief).
Hatchet: 10 damage against John Doe.

characters.name: Elliot
characters.summary: Pizza delivery boy: throws healing pizzas and rushes allies out of danger.

passives.name: Order Up!
passives.description: Each repaired generator adds +2 pizza healing (max +10).

passives.name: Deliverer's Resolve
passives.description: Sees the aura of any survivor who takes damage for 12 s.

abilities.name: Pizza Throw
abilities.description: Throws a pizza: whoever picks it up heals 5 + 15 over time (+2 per generator). Lasts 15 s; Elliot cannot eat his own. Not for Veeronica.

abilities.name: Rush Hour
abilities.description: Charges from healing others (start 1, max 3). Near the killer (85 studs): spends all for Speed (level = charges) 4 s; 2+ charges also give Exhausted II 4 s after.

bot.notes: Throws pizza at any ally below 60% HP in range; Rush Hour when chased with charges.

changes: HP 80 (brief: [assumed] 100).
Pizza heals 5 + 15 over time, +2 per generator up to +10 (brief: 35 HP, +5% per task); cooldown 30 s (brief: 45 s); lasts 15 s.
Rush Hour is a charge-based speed burst near the killer (brief: speed charge from eating pizza).

characters.name: Builderman
characters.summary: Roblox's builder: a slowing sentry and a healing dispenser he can carry around.

abilities.name: Sentry
abilities.description: Build for 6 s (damage cancels). 30 HP turret shooting the killer within 65 studs: Slowness II 1 s, Bleeding II 2 s and ~0.65 damage per shot. One per Builderman.

abilities.name: Dispenser
abilities.description: Build for 6 s. 15 HP; heals survivors within 16 studs by 1 HP/s. One per Builderman.

abilities.name: Carry / Place
abilities.description: Pick up a nearby building (inactive while carried, -10% speed, no sprint; 10+ damage destroys it). Press again to place it.

bot.notes: Builds the Sentry at a chokepoint near the generator he works on, the Dispenser near hurt allies.

changes: One Sentry and one Dispenser per Builderman (brief: up to 9 sentries / 14 dispensers).
Sentry: Slowness II 1 s per shot (brief: Slowness 2 s), 30 HP, 65-stud range; Dispenser heals 1 HP/s in 16 studs (brief: 0.9 HP/s).
New third ability Carry / Place.

characters.name: Dusekkar
characters.summary: Staff-wielding mage who shields allies through walls and zaps the killer.

passives.name: Levitation
passives.description: No footstep sounds; unaffected by John Doe's trail.

abilities.name: Spawn Protection
abilities.description: Channel a shield on the ally you look at (95 studs, through walls) for up to 3.5 s: Resistance IV and one lethal hit nullified. Dusekkar is slowed 30%. Same ally only every 30 s.

abilities.name: Plasma Beam
abilities.description: 2 s windup (-25% speed), then a 75-stud beam through walls. Killer: Slowness I 4 s. One survivor: Speed I 3 s + 25 overheal (decays).

bot.notes: Spawn Protection on a chased ally in view; Plasma Beam on the killer during chases.

changes: Spawn Protection: Resistance IV for up to 3.5 s (brief: 8 s) and it nullifies one lethal hit.
Plasma Beam: Slowness I 4 s on the killer (brief: Slowness II 3 s); survivors get Speed I 3 s + 25 overheal (wiki page; Statistics says 30). Cooldown 28 s (brief: 20 s).

characters.name: Taph
characters.summary: Trap-maker with alarm tripwires and a reality-bending Subspace Tripmine.

abilities.name: Tripwire
abilities.description: Place a wire (max 3, arms in 1.5 s, 10 HP). The killer crossing it is revealed to all survivors for 8 s and gets Slowness II 4 s.

abilities.name: Subspace Tripmine
abilities.description: Throw a near-invisible mine. A killer within 19 studs sets it off 0.5 s later: Helpless I 3 s, Subspaced III 6 s, Weakness V 6 s. Attacked first: only Subspaced I. Self-destructs after 50 s; -10 s cooldown when it hits.

bot.notes: Tripwires on approach routes to the generator he works on, mines near occupied generators.

changes: Tripwire gives Slowness II 4 s and reveals the killer to all survivors 8 s; it never expires (fades over 150 s) — brief said ~80 s.
Subspace Tripmine: trigger range 19 studs (brief 16), Helpless I 3 s (brief 5 s) + Subspaced III + Weakness V 6 s; self-detonates after 50 s (brief 35 s).
